name: transfer_station
title: Motic / Newport · dry-transfer station
identity: Motic PSM-1000, Newport 481-A, GON40-L and Fiber-Lite MI-150

rotation_mechanism.limits: Tangent coupling is a small-angle linear surrogate; cable strain and thermal processes are not modeled.

workholder_services.model: Visual slack service loops; all unmeasured routes/connectors are reconstructions, not strain/contact models.

service_envelope.reason: Attached heater and vacuum services: re-route or disconnect services before larger rotations; cable loads are not simulated.
service_envelope.basis: Tested operating envelope for reconstructed attached-service routes, not a calibrated hardware hard stop.
service_envelope.stamp_setup: Rest/retracted configuration; stamp approach into these routes requires a separate clearance check.

illumination.model: relative intensity surrogate; lamp spectrum and warm-up uncalibrated

imaging.light_path_calibration: Three-position selector is a declared approximation to the photographed head; exact fitted splitter version unverified.

assumptions: Stage screw pitch 0.5 mm/rev and unmarked carriage travel estimated. Goniometer range ±5 degrees from Newport. Glass/stamp contact is rigid; adhesion is a separate surrogate.

contact_mechanics.coupling_relation: output = ratio * input; input/output/ratio metadata remains unchanged
contact_mechanics.friction_units: N m for hinge joints, N for slide joints
contact_mechanics.calibration: Numerical stabilization with estimated friction; no measured torque, compliance, backlash, or mass calibration is claimed.
contact_mechanics.scope: Preserves geometry, masses, inertias, existing gravity compensation, and active fixture forces. Adds no holding actuators or position overwrites.
limitations: Flexible hoses and fibers are visual surfaces without cable contact or strain physics.
Optical focus handwheels are fixed visual geometry; the optical-head slide has physics but no rotary handwheel transmission.
